name: dsh-heartprint
description: 心印：记忆类插件。可以设置性格、人格，给它取名字；有情绪，介意勿下载；有淡忘功能，只淡忘琐碎无用的信息，重要的事情会经过分析保留；会记得你跟它之间最重要的事情；有特殊事件功能，特殊意义的事情会被记住。
author: youchen-yc

scripts.test: node --test test/engine.test.mjs test/tool.test.mjs test/regression.test.mjs test/alignment.test.mjs test/security.test.mjs test/release.test.mjs test/fsguard.test.mjs
scripts.verify: node --test test/engine.test.mjs test/tool.test.mjs test/regression.test.mjs test/alignment.test.mjs test/security.test.mjs test/release.test.mjs test/fsguard.test.mjs && node scripts/secret-scan.mjs && node scripts/sbom.mjs --check && node scripts/release-check.mjs
